items.quote: **What it cannot accept:** It cannot accept redefining truth as whatever is politically useful, whatever a majority agrees upon, or whatever an authority decrees. It cannot accept truth relative to a person, a class, a culture, or an epoch. Truth does not have different frames, just one: reality. Logic can tell what is congruent inside a model or a story; it cannot tell whether the story is real. It cannot accept altering a hypothesis after the fact to claim a failed prediction was actually correct.
